caption: Systematic encoding of 1101 with g(x) = x³ + x + 1. The shifted message is divided, the remainder 1 becomes parity 001, and the codeword is 1101001; the message bits pass through unchanged.

spec.title: Encoding 1101 with g(x) = x³ + x + 1
spec.aria: Flow for encoding 1101: shift by x cubed, divide by x cubed plus x plus 1, remainder 1 becomes parity 001, codeword 1101001.
